case.summary: Case HHG-001 was initiated after in-person transaction 3514030 for $77.07 on card C12382-K1 (customer C12382) on 2016-12-04 19:55:28 was flagged for out-of-region use in billing region 444. This card-present transaction occurred in a region accounting for only 2.8% of prior activity while home activity continued in parallel, resulting in a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92. Customer C12382 was contacted and confirmed that they still possessed the physical card and did not authorize the purchase. Based on the confirmed unauthorized activity, the verdict is fraud with total exposure of $77.07, and the card was blocked.
